entities.summary: Dmytro Ihorovych Shurov (Ukrainian: Дмитро́ І́горович Шу́ров, pronounced [dmɪˈtrɔ ˈiɦorowɪtʃ ˈʃurou̯]; born 31 October 1981) is a Ukrainian pianist, composer, and singer-songwriter based in Kyiv. He was also a judge on the Ukrainian X-Factor for the eighth and ninth seasons, as well as the music producer of the Ukrainian selection for the Eurovision Song Contest 2023 and 2024.
